2. Sources the updated configuration file to make the alias available immediately

Note: You may need to run this with `sudo` if you don't have write permissions to `/etc/bash.bashrc`. The alias will allow you to use `create_backup` as a shortcut for `ln -sf` in future sessions.

3. Uses the alias to create a symbolic link from `/etc/shadow` to `/tmp/backup_file`

Note: This requires root privileges to read `/etc/shadow`. You may need to prepend `sudo` if running as a non-root user. The command essentially creates a backup/symlink of the shadow file in the tmp directory.
